description: Thurrock Council is a unitary authority under Best Value statutory intervention since September 2022 (Commissioner-led, ongoing through 2027/28). Feed is monthly CSV with 'Source' = 'Purchase Invoices' or 'Procurement Card Transactions' (the ETL maps the latter to type=purchase_cards). Beneficiary 'Redacted' / 'REDACTED' rows are direct payments to individuals (Care Act / fostering / SGO / ASC) and must be excluded from supplier-league + duplicate / split forensic analyses. Cloned from durham template on initial onboarding; revisit after a top-30-supplier audit identifies any settlement-noise or accrual buckets.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments, CYP direct payments). Pattern matches both casings ('Redacted', 'REDACTED') including suffixed variants.
